author: km-arc
name: Naravel application
description: A Naravel web application: routing, events, queue, mail, cache and database configured with one file per module, a welcome page, a health check and a test project that uses the fakes. It needs no database server, no Redis and no broker.

NaravelVersion.description: The version of the Naravel packages the application references. The default is the version of this template pack.

AppRootNamespace.description: The name given with -n, made safe to use as a C# namespace (my-blog becomes my_blog, 1st becomes _1st). The C# files, RootNamespace and the cache key prefix use this.

AppProjectName.description: The name given with -n, exactly as it was given: the name of the project file and of the tests folder, which a path inside a file has to repeat. The engine writes a safe form (my_blog) for sourceName inside a file, so a path must not use sourceName.
